ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 3-5% high-intensity (white) punctate regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark/black pigmentation across approximately 95% of the surface area. High-contrast white circular and annular (ring-shaped) blobs are distributed throughout, with higher spatial density in the upper-left and upper-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks; the right lobe exhibits more irregular and pronounced jagged peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to acute, slightly upward-swept tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular white pixel clusters and annular motifs (barnacle scars) distributed across the dorsal-lateral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear greyish-white disruptions (scratches) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; a distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the extreme right tip of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique distribution of high-contrast 'donut-shaped' white rings of varying diameters scattered against the black fluke surface.
